# venues.json reference

`paperpush/venues.json` describes each venue's **submission form**: the fields the
portal asks for and the constraints on each. The top-level object maps a venue
slug (`biorxiv`, `nature`, ...) to a venue entry. This page is generated from
`paperpush/venues.schema.json`, which is itself generated from the `Venue` and
`Field` dataclasses in `paperpush/database.py` -- those are the source of truth.

A venue entry either stands alone or **inherits** another venue's entry. An
inheriting entry (`"inherits": "<slug>"`) takes the base venue's keys and
fields wholesale, then overrides individual top-level keys, modifies or adds
fields by `id` (restating only the keys that change; a key set to `null` drops
the inherited value), and drops fields listed in `removed_fields`.

## Venue entry

The keys of one venue entry (the value under a slug).

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | Display name. Defaults to the slug when omitted. |
| `fields` | list of [field](#field) | The fields this venue asks for during submission (see the field table). |
| `full_name` | string | Full, unabbreviated venue name. |
| `submission_url` | string | Submission/portal URL. |
| `venue_type` | `preprint` \| `journal` \| `conference` | Kind of venue: a preprint server, a journal, or a conference. |
| `site_url` | string | Public homepage URL. |
| `submission_guide` | string | URL of the author/submission guide. |
| `description` | string | Short description of the venue. |
| `file_type_options` | list of string or null | Labels offered by the portal's per-file 'file type' dropdown (venue-level because the same dropdown applies to every upload). |
| `max_upload_mb` | number or null | Maximum combined size, in megabytes, of all files in one submission. |
| `deprecated` | boolean | Hidden from listings but still reachable by get_venue. |
| `inherits` | string | Slug this venue inherits its field schema from. Empty/absent for a standalone venue. Distinct from submission sharing (which portal/runner/login a venue submits through), which is defined in code, not here. |
| `removed_fields` | list of string | Inherited field ids to drop. Only meaningful on an inheriting venue. |

## field

One entry of a venue's `fields` list: a value the portal asks for. In a
standalone venue every field is a full definition (`id`, `label`, and `type`
required). In an inheriting venue a field entry is an override: only `id` is
required, every other key is optional, and `null` deletes the inherited key.

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` (required) | string | Stable identifier, unique within the venue; the key used in the .sub file and for inheritance merges. |
| `label` (required) | string | Human-readable prompt shown for the field. |
| `type` (required) | `text` \| `textarea` \| `choice` \| `multichoice` \| `boolean` \| `int` \| `file` \| `filelist` \| `authorlist` | Widget/value kind. |
| `required` | boolean | Whether submission requires a value. |
| `help` | string | Guidance shown alongside the field. |
| `options` | list of string or null | Allowed values for `choice`/`multichoice`. |
| `options_file` | string or null | Name of a newline-separated keyword file under `venues/_assets/` whose lines become this field's `options`. Lets a long controlled vocabulary live in one shared text file instead of being inlined (and duplicated) in the database. When set, it supersedes any inline `options`. |
| `options_recommended` | boolean | For a `choice`/`multichoice` field, whether `options` is advisory (a value outside the list is a WARNING, not an ERROR) rather than a closed set. |
| `default` | any | Default value (any JSON type). |
| `accept` | list of string or null | Permitted file extensions for `file`/`filelist`, e.g. [".pdf", ".docx"]. Omit (not []) when the upload imposes no extension restriction. |
| `fields` | list of string or null | Sub-field (column) names for a structured multi-item field such as an `authorlist` or a pipe-delimited `textarea` (funding, suggested reviewers). Each item line is `\|`-delimited in this order. A trailing `?` marks an optional column (e.g. `department?`); every other column is required -- validation flags an item whose required column is blank. Author name and the `corresponding` flag have their own checks and are always effectively required regardless of marker. |
| `type_options` | list of string or null | Per-file 'file type' dropdown choices applied to this field's uploads. |
| `min_count` | integer or null | Inclusive lower bound on item count for a multi-item field (multichoice selections, filelist/authorlist/list-textarea lines). |
| `max_count` | integer or null | Inclusive upper bound on item count for a multi-item field. |
| `word_count` | integer or null | Maximum length in words for a `text`/`textarea` value. |
| `character_count` | integer or null | Maximum length in characters for a `text`/`textarea` value, or for the free text of a `choice` with `options_recommended`. |
| `min_character_count` | integer or null | Minimum length in characters for a `text`/`textarea` value (the lower-bound counterpart to `character_count`). |
| `require_url` | boolean or null | For a `text`/`textarea`, require each non-blank line of the value to be a valid http/https URL. |
| `max_words_before_refs` | integer or null | For a manuscript `file`, the maximum word count of the main text before the reference list. |
| `max_pages_before_refs` | integer or null | For a manuscript `file` (PDF), the maximum page count before the reference list. |
| `main_text_end_headings` | list of string or null | For a manuscript `file`, headings *other than the reference list* that end the main text for the `*_before_refs` limits (e.g. `Appendix`, `Ethics Statement`) -- sections the venue excludes from its word/page count. Each is a heading phrase matched on a line of its own; the earliest match, references included, ends the main text. When set, a heading that starts its own page (only a running head or page number ahead of it) counts the main text as ending on the previous page. |
| `max_words` | integer or null | For a manuscript `file`, the maximum word count of the whole document (references included). |
| `max_pages` | integer or null | For a manuscript `file`, the maximum page count of the whole document. Verified for PDF; for .docx a best-effort cached count. |
| `max_words_before_refs_by` | [ConditionalLimit](#conditionallimit) or null | `max_words_before_refs` selected by a sibling field's value (e.g. by article type). |
| `max_pages_before_refs_by` | [ConditionalLimit](#conditionallimit) or null | `max_pages_before_refs` selected by a sibling field's value. |
| `max_words_by` | [ConditionalLimit](#conditionallimit) or null | `max_words` selected by a sibling field's value. |
| `max_pages_by` | [ConditionalLimit](#conditionallimit) or null | `max_pages` selected by a sibling field's value (e.g. Bioinformatics' page cap by article type). |
| `min_value` | integer or null | Inclusive lower bound on the numeric value of an `int` field. |
| `max_value` | integer or null | Inclusive upper bound on the numeric value of an `int` field. |
| `max_file_size_mb` | number or null | Maximum size, in megabytes, of each individual file uploaded for a `file`/`filelist` field. Distinct from the venue-level max_upload_mb. |
| `autofill` | `extract` \| `classify` \| `filemap` \| `never` \| `` | How an autofill engine may populate the field: extract \| classify \| filemap \| never. Empty string means infer from `type`. |
| `confirm` | boolean | For a required `boolean`, whether it is a consent checkbox that must be affirmative (vs. an informational yes/no question). |
| `required_if` | string or null | Id of another field in the same venue; when that field has a non-empty value, this field becomes required. A `boolean` target triggers only on an affirmative answer, since "no" means the dependent fields do not apply. Combined with `required` (unconditional). |

## ConditionalLimit

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `field` (required) | string | Id of the sibling field whose value selects the limit. |
| `values` (required) | map of integer | Map from the selector field's value to the limit that applies. |
| `default` | integer or null | Limit used when the selector's value is absent from `values`. None means no limit applies then. |
